hypothesis: A coherent local workbench or precise configuration tool reduces context switching and setup, not just rebrands a generic workspace.
baseline_candidates: Native terminal and harness launch workflow
VS Code workspace plus task/session tooling
Existing agent desktop client appropriate to accepted scope
OpenFeature-compatible configuration for a configuration-only contract
scenario: First select the accepted public job. For a workbench, launch two isolated projects and different harnesses, navigate current and archived sessions, inspect a tool error, restart, and resume safely. For configuration tooling, create and change scoped flags/secrets and verify applications observe precisely the intended values. Do not combine incomparable outcomes into one score.
failure_cases: Secret exposed in a preview or log
Missing external source works only from a warm cache
Desktop shell launches the wrong binary
